title: Brand Identity
summary: City Reliquary is a community-driven museum devoted to preserving New York City's history through everyday objects and personal collections. Unlike traditional museums that focus on grand historical narratives, City Reliquary highlights overlooked artifacts, neighborhood stories, and urban ephemera.

overview.challenge: City Reliquary is a community-driven museum devoted to preserving New York City's history through everyday objects and personal collections. Unlike traditional museums that focus on grand historical narratives, City Reliquary highlights overlooked artifacts, neighborhood stories, and urban ephemera.
overview.solution: I developed a compact CR mark that uses negative space to suggest a curated fragment, then extended the identity across posters, signage, and merchandise.
overview.outcome: The identity gives the museum a flexible visual system rooted in everyday artifacts and neighborhood history, with applications that can work across print, display, and apparel.
overview._notes: Copy refined to reflect the documented identity concept.

blocks.heading: A mark built around overlooked fragments
blocks.body: The identity began with the museum’s focus on everyday objects and personal collections. I explored a compact CR symbol and negative-space relationships, then tested how the mark could carry across different scales and applications.
